profile.summary: A nonprofit arts education organization based in Oakland, California. It offers youth programs in media, movement, music, theater and visual arts, including school-based instruction, a homeschool arts academy, summer camp and mural projects. It focuses on serving Black and Brown youth from under-resourced communities.

review.notes: The exact name, Oakland location and arts-education purpose match the agenda text and OUSD's Classroom & academic programs contracts (Prop 28 Arts and Music). The website lists school-based arts programs, homeschool academy, murals and summer camp, and ProPublica lists a 501(c)(3) 'Peoples Conservatory' in Oakland (EIN 83-0648381). The website does not state the EIN or name OUSD, so the registry link rests on name, city and purpose, but I found no competing similarly named organization.
